query: How to perform species- and drug-class-specific power calculations for AMR surveillance (balanced resistant/susceptible classes) and translate them into sample targets per site?

response.query: How to perform species- and drug-class-specific power calculations for AMR surveillance (balanced resistant/susceptible classes) and translate them into sample targets per site?
response.answer: To perform power calculations for AMR surveillance, use statistical software to determine sample size based on expected resistance rates and desired precision. Translate these calculations into sample targets per site by considering local prevalence and resource availability. Ensure balanced resistant/susceptible classes for accurate results.
